translations.web: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
translations.bsb: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
translations.kjv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
translations.asv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?
